ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based enhanced due diligence for all directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners and authorized signatories covering: (i) Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), family members and close associates as defined by the Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2008 and aligned to FATF Recommendations 12 and 22; (ii) screening against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, the UK OFSI Consolidated Sanctions List (which extends to Bermuda), the Bermuda Sanctions Orders made by Order in Council, and, as prudent risk-based practice consistent with BMA enforcement expectations, the US OFAC SDN List and EU consolidated lists; (iii) adverse media and global enforcement database search (World-Check or equivalent); (iv) source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification for the subscription price; (v) ongoing monitoring with sanctions re-screening at least daily and PEP status refresh at least annually; (vi) all screening results, risk ratings and sign-offs must be documented in the client due diligence file before incorporation is filed with the Registrar of Companies.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Companies e-Registry online portal operated by the Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda (Hamilton, Bermuda); name availability may also be checked through the legacy name-search facility at the Companies Registry, 4th Floor, Government Administration Building, 30 Parliament Street, Hamilton HM 12.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The operative corporate name must be expressed in the Latin (Roman) alphabet and must be capable of being read and recorded in English, which is the official language of the Bermuda Companies Register. A desired name in a non-Latin script (e.g., Chinese, Cyrillic, Arabic, Greek) must be transliterated into Latin characters for the registered name, and an English translation or explanation may be appended to the Memorandum of Association for clarity. Only the Latin-character English rendering has legal effect for registry, corporate signing and legalization purposes.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bermuda (where the name falsely implies government sponsorship, public authority status or Crown connection)
Any name identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered company or to a name reserved for a pending incorporation
Any name suggesting an illegal purpose or offending public morality
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon refusal of a proposed name, the Registrar of Companies issues a written refusal notice citing the statutory or discretionary ground under the Companies Act 1981. The incorporator may within 14 days of the refusal submit written representations and request reconsideration, attaching supporting evidence of distinctiveness and lawful use. If reconsideration is denied, the incorporator may appeal to the Minister of Finance within 30 days of the reconsideration decision by filing a notice of appeal together with the refusal letter and evidence of the prior name search. The Minister's decision is subject to judicial review by the Supreme Court of Bermuda by originating application filed within six weeks of the decision. In parallel, the incorporator may immediately lodge a new and materially different name clearance application, which requires a further non-refundable search fee. Name clearance fees are non-refundable upon refusal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure postal virtual office is not sufficient for the statutory registered office requirement. The registered office of a Bermuda Exempted Company must be a physical address in Bermuda maintained by a licensed Corporate Service Provider in compliance with the Corporate Service Provider Business Act 2000. For the remote screen-share and IoT telemetry software business profile, a virtual operational presence is permissible because no physical trading premises are required; however, if the Exempted Company holds or exploits the software intellectual property, it will be characterized as an intellectual property business under the Economic Substance (Companies) Rules 2018, and an address-only arrangement will not satisfy the substance thresholds for ledger board management and core income-generating activities in Bermuda.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: 15-25% probability of unannounced on-site inspection of the Exempted Company's registered office or documented mind-and-management location during Year 1, elevated by the intellectual property relevant-activity characterization and by the Bermuda Monetary Authority's current enforcement cycle targeting low-substance exempted companies. The licensed corporate service provider itself is subject to BMA on-site examination on a rolling three-year supervision cycle, and the Registrar of Companies may require production of corporate records at any time.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 1981 (Bermuda), as amended, principally sections 4, 5, 7, 8, 39 (registered office), 41 (secretary), 93-94 (exempted undertakings) and 220-224 (evidentiary provisions); read with the Companies (Fees) Regulations 2019 and the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies Registry, Department of Registry General, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda, Hamilton HM 12, Bermuda
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation issued upon filing of the Memorandum of Association, Articles of Association, Form 1 (Declaration of Compliance), Form 2 (Notice of Registered Office), and director consent forms
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; exempted companies may incorporate with par-value shares as low as USD 1 in total or with no-par capital; no escrow deposit is required by the Registrar; subscribed proceeds must be recorded in the register of members and may be held in any licensed bank or EMI
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: BE IT RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS: (1) The authorized ordinary share capital of the Company is confirmed as set out in the Memorandum of Association, and the subscribers shall subscribe for the shares allocated to them, with share certificates issued forthwith. (2) The registered office of the Company is established at the office of the licensed corporate service provider, Hamilton, Bermuda, and the same provider is appointed registered agent and resident secretary. (3) [Name A] and [Name B] are appointed as the first directors; [Name C] is appointed Chief Executive Officer and [Name D] is appointed Chief Financial Officer, each to serve until the first annual general meeting. (4) All ancillary incorporation filings, banking account openings and regulatory applications are ratified and delegated.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Bermuda Licensed Corporate Service Provider and Preliminary Anti-Money-Laundering Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed corporate service provider acting under the Companies Act 1981 and the Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2018
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the CSP engagement letter and complete the subscriber/director KYC file. Bermuda permits 100% non-resident ownership; no domestic participation is required. The CSP concurrently prepares the incorporation dossier and requests fee deposit, including the Registrar fee.
required_dossiers: AML/KYC questionnaire for each subscriber, director and officer
Certified passport and proof of residential address
Concise business description and target banking rails (Stripe, Paddle)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CSP compliance officer queries any beneficial owner, provide enhanced due diligence evidence (source of funds and corporate chart of the parent) within 48 hours; unresolved queries are escalated to a designated AML officer for a final eligibility decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Name Reservation Officer, Companies Registry (submitted via Registry e-Services)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The CSP files a name reservation request with three ranked alternatives, each ending in 'Limited' or 'Ltd'. The intended name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing Bermuda company and must not imply royal, governmental or regulated financial activity. Reservation is valid for a limited statutory window.
required_dossiers: Certificate of proposed names (three ranked alternatives)
Draft object clause summarising remote desktop access and IoT telemetry software services
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, the CSP immediately refiles a re-listing request with amended alternatives within the 5-working-day validity window; a written name-consent letter may be secured from the conflicting entity where the Registry permits coexistence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Execution and Lodgement of Incorporation Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry (Registrar of Companies), Government of Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association before a witness, complete Form 1 (Declaration of Compliance) and Form 2 (Notice of Registered Office), collect signed director consents, and submit the full package with the statutory filing fee via the CSP portal. The Certificate of Incorporation is typically issued within 2 to 5 business days if the file is in perfect order.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association signed by each subscriber
Consent to act as director of each proposed director
Proposed registered office consent letter from the CSP
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On a Registry requisition, the CSP corrects the defective instrument and refiles within the statutory 14-day response period; purely ministerial deficiencies carry no duplicate fee; if the Registry maintains an invalid refusal, the company may request written reasons and seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Bermuda.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Organizational Formalities, Share Issuance and Banking Connectivity
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors acting through the CSP registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting, pass the First Board Resolution adopted at formation, approve share subscriptions, issue share certificates, open the statutory registers, and execute banking/EMI account applications with the Certificate of Incorporation and board resolution. Account onboarding supports Stripe and Paddle payout settlement in USD.
required_dossiers: Register of Members, Directors and Share Certificates
Certified corporate extract and director identification for bank/EMI
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Latent defects in the share register are cured by a subsequent board resolution and restated registers; bank query responses are furnished via the CSP within 24 hours; if the EMI declines onboarding, an alternative licensed Bermuda or UK EMI is selected without re-filing with the Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Licensing, Premises Clearance and Annual Compliance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Licensing Office, Ministry of Economy and Labour (licensing), and Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service (premises)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the annual Business Licence application under the Business Licensing Act 2014, classifying the activity as technology services (remote screen-share and unattended machine telemetry software). Pay the estimated gross-receipts-based fee, register the office occupation, and obtain fire safety and electrical clearance for the Hamilton premises.
required_dossiers: Summary of services: remote desktop access and IoT telemetry SaaS
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A licence denial or conditional imposition may be appealed to the Business Licensing Authority within 14 days of notification; payment of the licence fee may be structured by written request where projected receipts materially shift; annual renewal remains calendar-linked and is tracked by the CSP.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business Licensing Office, Ministry of Economy and Labour (Business Licensing Authority established under the Business Licensing Act 2014)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Annual Business Licence - Technology Services (Remote Support Software and Unattended Machine Telemetry)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) / Environmental Authority, Government of Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (Office-Only Classification): no statutory EIA notification or registration required under the Development and Planning Act 1974 and Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations 2014, because the economic activity is pure software/SaaS with no industrial installation, manufacturing process or land disturbance; a simple waste-stream declaration suffices
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero industrial process wastewater discharge; only sanitary effluent to municipal sewer per Bermuda Public Health Regulations; no VOC-emitting production or combustion sources; e-waste (servers, screen-share gateways and IoT hardware) segregated and recycled through a permitted Bermuda recycler under the Integrated Solid Waste Management regime; all network equipment disposed in accordance with WEEE-equivalent collection rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service covering office premises; building occupancy approval under the Development and Planning Act 1974; workplace safety clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health framework administered by the Department of Labour; verification of electrical installations, emergency egress, alarm coverage and compliance with maximum office-occupancy load limits.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda Office of the Tax Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, for payroll tax and tax certificate matters; Bermuda Registrar of Companies, Companies Registry, for incorporation and statutory filings. Primary portal: Bermuda Companies Registry eServices and Bermuda OneGov.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Bermuda exempted company is incorporated under the Companies Act 1981 by filing a Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association with the Registrar of Companies, designating a resident registered office and principal. No corporate income tax TIN is issued because Bermuda imposes no income tax on companies. The entity receives a Bermuda company registration number at incorporation. If it will employ persons in Bermuda, it must separately enrol with the Office of the Tax Commissioner for employer payroll tax and obtain a payroll tax file number. If the company will import goods, it must also register a customs declaration profile with Bermuda Customs for ASYCUDA World.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election is available under Bermuda law. The material statutory election is an application for a Tax Exemption Certificate under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966, which guarantees that the exempted company will remain exempt from any future Bermudian direct taxes until at least March 2035. Additional optional designations include regulatory statuses such as a non-resident insurer or special purpose vehicle under sector-specific legislation, but none alters the default tax-exempt classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT, GST or sales and use tax in Bermuda. The indirect tax analogues are customs duties on imported goods and payroll tax on Bermudian employers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable for VAT/GST because no such tax exists. Employers have payroll tax registration obligations once they have any remuneration paid to a Bermudian employee, and importers must declare goods through Bermuda Customs regardless of turnover. There is no economic threshold for indirect tax registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No national VAT e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, or digital stamping mandate exists. Import and export entries are filed electronically through Bermuda Customs using ASYCUDA World. Businesses must retain underlying invoices and shipping documents for audit inspection.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. Bermuda does not levy VAT or GST and has no export zero-rating procedure. Services supplied by a Bermuda exempted company, including remote desktop support, screen sharing, and IoT telemetry software, are outside the scope of Bermudian indirect taxation. The relevant export-related tax relief is the direct tax exemption conferred by exempted company status and the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 certificate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration via ASYCUDA World electronic Bill of Entry
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing transportation
Original or certified certificate of origin where required by the consignee jurisdiction
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank payment evidence where export proceeds are repatriated through a Bermuda bank
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: There is no VAT export fraud or clawback regime because Bermuda has no VAT. Audit scrutiny instead focuses on the Economic Substance Act 2018, payroll tax compliance, customs declaration accuracy, and continued eligibility for exempted company status and the 2035 tax protection certificate. Submitting false information in support of exempted status can result in loss of the tax exemption certificate, monetary penalties, and regulatory sanctions. Under the Tax Administration Act 2014, inaccurate returns and records attract civil penalties, and customs offences may lead to forfeiture and additional fines.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Bermuda's financial system operates under the Bermuda Monetary Authority as the de facto central bank and exchange control administrator. The Bermudian dollar is pegged 1:1 to the United States dollar; however, US dollars are legal tender in normal commerce. Both capital and current account transactions are fully convertible, with no foreign exchange controls, restrictions on dividend distribution or bottlenecks to profit remittance. For a Bermuda Exempted Company engaged in remote screen-share/IoT software, repatriation of profits to shareholders is unhindered, provided the company maintains the required economic substance in Bermuda and observes anti-money laundering reporting under the Proceeds of Crime Regulations 2008 (as amended). Banks apply standard enhanced due diligence for non-resident owned exempted companies, and the absence of an income tax treaty network means that remittance documentation must support the underlying commercial substance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Bermuda imposes no mandatory export proceeds surrender timeline or conversion ratio. Export receipts from software licences, IoT telemetry subscriptions, and remote support fees may be retained in Bermudian dollars, US dollars, or any freely convertible foreign currency at the discretion of the entity. The BMA maintains exchange control forms for statistical and anti-money-laundering purposes, but no surrender or conversion mandates apply.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium. Bermuda is not a principal European or Commonwealth EMI (electronic money institution) licensing centre; the BMA's Digital Asset Business Act covers digital asset activity but not eu-licensed EMI status. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise or Revolut Business can be integrated as ancillary payment rails for collecting small-volume SaaS fees, but they are not regulated by the BMA and often restrict onboarding of Bermuda-registered corporate entities lacking local operational substance. Consequently, the primary treasury account should be held with a licensed Bermuda commercial bank, with EMIs used only for multi-currency collection and zero/low-balance clearing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Bermuda law does not require directors to appear physically before a bank; however, every Bermuda commercial bank applies the AML/ATF Code of Conduct which entails a face-to-face interview or live video verification for non-resident directors. In practice, at least one director or the authorised signatory must attend an in-person appointment at a branch, a correspondent bank, or the offices of the company's registered agent. Remote opening is conditionally possible when documents are notarised and apostilled, the registered agent provides an introducer letter, and a video conference is held; but this is at the bank's discretion.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound equity contribution from an overseas holding company or individual without a clear source-of-wealth audit trail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements of the remitter, bank reference letter from the originating bank, source-of-funds declaration, board resolution on capital allocation, share issue certificate and register, sales invoices, and customer contracts demonstrating the business purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex cross-border shareholding chain with intermediate entities in low-tax or ministerial registries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified corporate structure chart, register of members and PSC (People with Significant Control) schedule, copies of trust deeds or registered agent service agreements, legitimate business rationale letters, and independent legal opinion on ownership transparency.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt entity status combined with recurring international SaaS receipts triggering tax residency and economic substance review
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bermuda Economic Substance (ES) notification and substance declaration filings, payroll records and employment contracts, board meeting minutes held in Bermuda, office lease or service arrangement with a Bermuda service provider, and complete FATCA/CRS compliance records.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections are effected via SWIFT MT103 with a purpose description indicating equity subscription or capital contribution. The receiving Bermuda bank will require the share allotment certificate and an authorising board resolution; transactions exceeding the BMA's exchange control reporting threshold must be declared on the applicable Bermuda Exchange Control form. The bank will also perform sanctions screening and verify the beneficial owner register under Bermuda's AML legislation. No prior BMA approval is needed for an exempted company's capital call, but documentary retention for five years is required.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for remote screen share and IoT licence fees are cleared primarily by SWIFT MT103 messages using standard correspondent banking routes. Commercial letters of credit are not the appropriate or customary instrument for intangible software services; disbursements for royalties, vendor support, and intercompany costs are executed via high-value wire transfers or through cloud-based banking APIs. Payment facilitators (Stripe, Paddle) deposit aggregated net revenues into the Bermuda bank account via ACH/SEPA equivalent rails after deducting processing fees. Bank-to-bank SWIFT is the final clearing and settlement layer for treasury transfers.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards (USD versus EUR, GBP, CAD, and AUD) with a licensed bank or a recognised broker-dealer, typically up to 24 months.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for non-convertible or thinly traded currencies (for example offshore CNY, INR, or NGN) provided the underlying exposure originates from verified SaaS or telemetry contracts.
Plain-vanilla cross-currency swaps for long-term intercompany loans denominated in EUR or GBP.
Vanilla European-style FX options to hedge multi-currency receivables collected via Stripe or Paddle.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies Registry, Government of Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after each anniversary of incorporation, or on such anniversary-based renewal date as the Registrar of Companies specifies in the annual return notice; at least one return is required each calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deliver the annual return is a continuing offence; default fines may be issued, the company may be flagged on the Register, and continuing default authorises the Registrar to strike the company off and cancel its exemption certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Exempted Company Annual Public Fee (Companies Act 1981 Fee Schedule)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies / Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 August of each year, or the alternative due date shown on the Registrar's annual fee invoice for anniversary-based assessments.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid annual fees accrue statutory late-payment penalties; continued non-payment is a direct strike-off trigger under the Companies Act 1981 and may result in loss of exempted status with retroactive tax exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance / Annual Notification Return (Economic Substance (Bermuda) Act 2018, where the company is a resident entity carrying on a relevant activity, including intellectual-property holding)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Economic Substance Unit, Government of Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the end of each financial year; for a 31 December year-end, by 30 June of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing is punishable by fixed and continuing daily penalties; material false statements attract penalties up to USD 250,000; continued non-compliance may lead to strike-off and referral to the Bermuda courts.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory revenue or asset threshold applies to a Bermuda Exempted Company under the Companies Act 1981. An independent audit becomes compulsory where audited accounts are required by the company's bye-laws or shareholders, by a Bermuda Monetary Authority licence, or by the Economic Substance (Bermuda) Act 2018 / assessor's direction, including for a relevant IP business.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB is the standard framework for Bermuda exempted companies with no domestic Bermuda GAAP; US GAAP is acceptable for SEC-reporting or US-parented groups.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual beneficial ownership confirmation is effected at the annual return date: the directors or local representative must confirm the Register of Beneficial Owners reflects current ownership, and any change in beneficial ownership arising from a share transfer is filed with the Companies Registry within the statutory reporting window of 30 days. There is no public UBO disclosure for an exempted company; the register is held at the registered office and filed confidentially with the Registrar.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of shareholders' and directors' meetings and resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$2,000–US$4,500 per annum for a Bermuda-licensed registered-office/corporate-services provider, including local registered office and company secretary support.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$6,000–US$18,000 for a non-regulated, low-activity Exempted Company; US$15,000–US$40,000 if consolidated group financial statements or Economic Substance audit evidence are required.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for Bermuda Exempted Companies outside the scope of the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 (CIT Act); 15% for Constituent Entities of in-scope MNE Groups whose consolidated group revenue equals or exceeds EUR 750 million in at least one of the two preceding fiscal years. The CIT Act takes effect for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2025.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero effective CIT for the standard exempted company: no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no dividend tax, no branch profits tax, and no capital duty. The only annual fiscal burden is the statutory Government fee (approximately BMD 1,995 to BMD 59,640 per year depending on authorised share capital class, reassessed annually by Order). In-scope MNE groups benefit from the Economic Transition Adjustment, domestic minimum top-up relief, and OECD GloBE-compatible transitional safe harbours under the CIT Act 2023. Employer payroll tax (up to 10.5% on Bermuda payroll) and social insurance contributions remain payable where Bermuda employees are engaged, but these are not corporate income taxes.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Economic Substance Declaration (ESD) - filed electronically with the Registrar of Companies through the Government of Bermuda e-Services Portal (GoB eServices). No standalone corporate income tax return is required for out-of-scope exempted companies; the ESD is the principal annual fiscal compliance filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within six (6) months after the end of the financial year; a Bermudian entity with a 31 December year-end must file by 30 June of the following year (Economic Substance (Submission of Declaration) Rules 2018).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered entity name, registration number, and former names.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact name and number as recorded on the Certificate of Incorporation; foreign trade names or platform names must not be substituted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial year-end date and commencement date of the first accounting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Align the period with the consolidated financial statements and the revenue recognition model used for the remote screen-share and IoT telemetry software subscriptions under IFRS 15.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Relevant activity indicator: yes/no declaration and applicable activity code.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select 'Provision of services' and, where applicable, 'Intellectual property business' for platform software licensing income. Avoid the 'pure equity holding entity' classification because it carries a lower substance bar and invites HMRC scrutiny.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Jurisdiction(s) in which the entity is resident for tax purposes and any foreign tax identification number (TIN).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the UK group asserts management and control in Bermuda, declare Bermuda-only residence and document board minutes. If a UK PE exists, provide the UK TIN and disclose the foreign filing obligation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Core Income Generating Activities (CIGAs) performed in Bermuda.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe head-office functions, strategic product decisions, contract negotiation oversight, and local governance. Do not claim CIGAs performed by UK-based software developers or UK support personnel.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income attributable to the Bermuda entity from the relevant activity (BMD).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the full subscription revenue booked in Bermuda, reconciling to Stripe/Paddle payout records and the audited or management financial statements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of full-time employees physically working in Bermuda.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A zero-employee company must provide a written explanation of how economic substance is satisfied, e.g., through a Bermuda outsourced administrator directed by local management.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual operating expenditure on CIGAs performed in Bermuda (BMD).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include Bermuda payroll, rent, professional fees, and local IT infrastructure costs. Exclude intra-group management fees paid to the UK related entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Place and record of board and strategic decision-making.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide physical addresses where Bermuda-resident directors meet. Remote attendance from the UK weakens the management-and-control test and may be treated as a sham by HMRC and the Registrar.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the ESD attracts a fine of BMD 10,000. Non-compliance with an economic substance notice or the provision of false information is punishable on indictment by a fine of up to BMD 250,000 and imprisonment for up to 7 years. The Registrar may impose daily default penalties (commonly BMD 2,000 per day) and may strike the company off the Register for repeated non-filing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Companies Act 1981 - Annual Return of Exempted Company (s. 241) - filed electronically with the Registrar of Companies via GoB eServices.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 60 days of each anniversary of the date of incorporation. An audit is not mandatory for most exempted companies unless shareholder resolutions or the CIT Act in-scope status require one.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name, registration number, and date of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match the Certificate of Incorporation and the ESD filing exactly.
A physical Bermuda address maintained by a licensed corporate services provider is mandatory; a P.O. box alone is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, including classes of shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report in BMD or USD; the annual Government fee is calculated from this field, so accuracy is critical.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and officers, including dates of appointment and residential addresses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; identify which directors are Bermuda-resident to support the ESR management-and-control test.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company secretary and resident representative details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The resident representative must be an individual or licensed firm in Bermuda; foreign secretaries are not sufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of no unregistered charges or constitutional document changes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach certified copies of any amendments to the memorandum and articles and register any charges within 29 days of creation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a statutory penalty of BMD 500, with the Registrar empowered to impose additional default fees for continued failure. Persistent non-filing results in strike-off and dissolution of the company, freezing of bank accounts, and forfeiture of assets. Directors may be ordered to pay restoration costs personally.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Return (CIT Act 2023) - filed with the Office of the Tax Commissioner through the Bermuda CIT e-filing portal. This return applies only to Constituent Entities of in-scope MNE groups with consolidated revenue of EUR 750 million or more; standard out-of-scope exempted companies do not file this form.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual for in-scope MNE groups; not applicable for out-of-scope exempted companies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 15 months after the end of the fiscal year (18 months for the first GloBE transitional filing period).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Group identification: UPE name, jurisdiction of ultimate parent, global entity identifier, and country-by-country report filing status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Bermuda constituent entity must reference the ultimate parent entity data and the OECD GloBe Information Return (GIR) filed by the UPE in its own jurisdiction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bermuda domestic top-up tax computation and GloBE income or loss.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute covered taxes, substance-based income exclusion, and any qualified domestic minimum top-up tax (QDMTT) safe harbour; cross-border attribution to the UK group must be arm's length.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Effective tax rate reconciliation and deferred tax recalculations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide supporting schedules for the Economic Transition Adjustment and any GloBE Recapture Rule exposure arising from UK or US profits booked in Bermuda.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the CIT return attracts a fine of up to BMD 10,000 plus daily default penalties; fraudulent or grossly negligent statements attract a fine of up to BMD 250,000 and imprisonment on indictment; unpaid CIT bears interest and late-payment penalties that may reach 25% of the tax understated. These penalties are personal to the directors and officers where the default is committed with their consent or neglect.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%. Bermuda imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by a Bermuda Exempted Company to shareholders of any residence, and no withholding tax on distributions in liquidation or on deemed distributions. The UK does not levy withholding tax on dividend payments from a UK payer to a Bermuda recipient under the UK dividend exemption, but the UK anti-abuse diverted profits tax and CFC rules must be considered where a Bermuda entity is interposed in a digital subscription chain.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because Bermuda levies zero withholding tax, no intra-group gross-up is required on ordinary dividends or interest. To invoke relief against UK or other treaty partner taxes on cross-border service or royalty income, the exempted company must (i) establish beneficial ownership and substantive operations in Bermuda; (ii) apply to the Bermuda Office of the Tax Commissioner for a Certificate of Tax Residence in the prescribed form (COR-B), supported by board minutes, payroll, and local expenditure evidence; (iii) submit the certificate together with a formal treaty claim to HMRC or the counterpart revenue authority; and (iv) ensure the claim aligns with the OECD Multilateral Instrument and the principal purpose test. The UK-Bermuda Double Taxation Arrangement and the 2008 Tax Information Exchange Agreement provide exchange-of-information and limited mutual agreement procedures but do not constitute a comprehensive income tax treaty and do not reduce UK withholding taxes.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Outbound from Bermuda: 0% statutory withholding tax on both intellectual property royalties and debt interest. Inbound into Bermuda: 0% withholding tax on payments to non-residents, with no exchange control or stamp duty on such cross-border payments. For UK-source royalties paid by a UK customer or UK group company to the Bermuda entity, UK statutory withholding tax of 20% applies under ITA 2007 ss. 906 and 874 and is not reduced by the UK-Bermuda arrangement. Payments for the outright sale of software or for cloud subscription access that does not amount to a royalty can be structured outside UK royalty withholding if no UK PE exists; however, the re-characterisation risk under UK source rules and the OECD treaty override rules requires a documented legal analysis.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory local-file or master-file documentation obligation for out-of-scope Bermuda Exempted Companies because no corporate income tax applies to them. For in-scope MNE groups under the CIT Act 2023, arm's length transfer pricing is mandatory and aligned with the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines, with the compliance trigger being group consolidated revenue of EUR 750 million (approximately BMD 750 million, at parity) in a preceding fiscal year rather than a transaction-level threshold. A prudent risk-management documentation threshold for intercompany service fees in the remote screen-share and IoT telemetry business is BMD 1,000,000 of relevant turnover; below this amount quarterly transfer pricing memos are recommended, and above this amount a full OECD-compliant benchmarking study should be maintained.
